content:
Anita: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I want to lock in remediation owners and timelines for the GPU autoscale surge last week. I sketched items below, please reply with ownership or edits.

Maya: reading now. do we have a prioritized order?

Anita: Priority 1 = immediate quota/backstop to prevent hard OOMs. Priority 2 = scheduler tuning (pod binpacking + draining behavior). Priority 3 = headroom modelling and runbook updates.

Sam: I can own quota/backstop changes. Will propose a short-lived burst-credit policy and a permanent quota increase request. Target: PR by Fri 09:00 PT. :white_check_mark:

Joel: I’ll take headroom modelling and simulation. I’ll run a 2-week traffic replay against our autoscaler to find safe headroom bands and produce a heatmap. ETA: next Tue EOD.

Li: I can handle scheduler knobs + canary. Plan: tweak preemption thresholds and pod eviction backoff, run canary on staging, then prod canary during low-traffic window. I’ll post exact kube configs.

Maya: I’ll do the runbook and postmortem follow-up doc, and add the new triage checklist items (what to check first: quotas, node pool saturation, hotspot models). ETA: Monday morning.

Anita: infra-bot, please create a tracking issue and ping rotation for on-call awareness.

infra-bot: Created issue #INC-4537: "gpu-burst-credit-and-scheduler-remediation" assigned to Anita, Sam, Li, Joel, Maya. Tracker link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4537

Sam: quick note - for burst-credit policy, we should gate by customer tier and model-class (large-context jobs should be capped). I’ll include a small policy matrix in the PR.

Li: sample HPA change I’ll test in staging (will iterate):
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: model-worker
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 60 # raised for canary
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 45
```
Will also test drain timing: `kubectl drain --grace-period=120 --ignore-daemonsets`.

Joel: also add KV cache warmup tracing so we can tell if many cold caches contributed to burst. Small change to rt-trace: add header X-Cache-Warmed and sample rate 1% in prod.

Maya: for the runbook, proposed immediate checklist (triage):
- confirm quotas (GPUs, burst credits)
- check node pool saturation (by AZ)
- check autoscaler scaling events and throttles
- confirm fallback model variants were used
- escalate to infra on <15m remaining headroom
I’ll link the checklist to the incident page.

Anita: thanks. owners and next steps: Sam -> quota PR (due Fri 09:00 PT), Li -> scheduler canary (staging->prod window Wed 02:00-04:00 PT), Joel -> headroom sims (Tue EOD), Maya -> runbook (Mon morning). I’ll follow up with weekly status checks until closed.

Sam: noted. I’ll post the PR and tag @Anita for review.

Li: staging canary scheduled for Tue 22:00 PT, prod canary Wednesday low traffic window if staging looks good.

Joel: posting initial sim results to INC-4537 by Monday; will include plots and recommended safety multiplier.

Maya: created doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/gpu-autoscale-2026-followup — added checklist and action table.

Anita: one more — recurring pattern detection: can someone add a metric alert for consecutive autoscaler throttles > 3 within 10m? That should preempt the surge pattern.

Sam: I’ll add the metric alert alongside the quota PR. rule: `sum(rate(autoscaler_throttle[5m])) by(cluster) > 3` -> page.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in for INC-4537 every Monday 09:30 PT until resolved.

Maya: Thanks team. If anything blocks owners, ping here; otherwise I’ll run the first status sync Monday 09:30 PT.

Anita: closing loop for now — appreciate the quick responses. :pray:
